SQLite save, close, reopen, idempotence, stale generation, snapshot
durable byte roundtrip, reopen, immutable rejection, hash rejection, removal
actual device credential save, read, clear
actual SQLite record/outbox atomicity and failed transaction preserves draft
native validated media, draft pins, CAS, source isolation and cleanup protection
native media promotion before SQL fault leaves recoverable journal and no visible ref
snapshot pins survive source removal and media-preserving import stays revision fenced
saved collection survives a full native app process restart
native corrupt/missing cache repair preserves draft/export pins and transaction fences
native source-preserving rebase validates review and archives drafts, media and old commands atomically
native document URLs stay outside ordinary project URL routing
native reviewed retention keeps missing saved refs but refuses missing draft media
native verified authentication resumes only matching-device auth failures
native epoch replacement preserves old drafts and bytes through transaction failure and retry
native recovered import publishes files and collection atomically after source staging
native transition rejects newly added drafts and stale identities; retained copy preserves draft media
native portable draft retains caller revision, normalized media, atomic pins and opening scope
native operation plans survive restart and failed save with immutable identity and media pins
native conflict recovery copies media before atomic retirement, preserves failures, and deduplicates retry
native downloaded cache eviction preserves protected/source bytes and retries physical cleanup
empty unchanged-cursor pull preserves real SQLite state, subscriptions and review CAS
late sync cleanup preserves a deliberate guest switch in the actual controller and SQLite
native runtime scheduler waits for startup and queued selection settlement
native durable workflow CAS and scope fences preserve deletion continuation across local removal
native billing remains unconfigured without an authenticated enrolled account
native restored-camera staging survives reopen and applies only to its original draft revision
native per-account device identity and verified offline label persist and clear
native Web Locks exclude a second foreground sync owner until release
actual native app/network subscriptions and microphone permission inspection
native WebView normalizes a synthetic photo to resized JPEG pixels
